title: Differentiability of the orthogonal projection onto the range of an injective linear map
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ and write ℝ^d := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) (= Rn d). Equip L(ℝⁿ, ℝᴺ) := (ℝⁿ →L[ℝ] ℝᴺ) and L(ℝᴺ, ℝᴺ) := (ℝᴺ →L[ℝ] ℝᴺ) with the operator norm. For B ∈ L(ℝⁿ, ℝᴺ) let Πr(B) := (LinearMap.range B.toLinearMap).starProjection ∈ L(ℝᴺ, ℝᴺ) be the orthogonal projection of ℝᴺ onto the range of B. If A ∈ L(ℝⁿ, ℝᴺ) is injective, then the map Πr : L(ℝⁿ, ℝᴺ) → L(ℝᴺ, ℝᴺ), B ↦ Πr(B), is Fréchet differentiable at A.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn N), Function.Injective A → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun B : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn N ↦ (LinearMap.range B.toLinearMap).starProjection) A
